notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented 2026-07-22: (1) CPU rayon parallelism on the hot per-cell loops (RICHARDS residual+numerical Jacobian, two-phase multiphase block residual+Jacobian, reactive-transport per-cell speciation) - deterministic (disjoint-index scatter), all tests still pass, Android-clean. (2) Optional wgpu GPU addon (src/gpu.rs) - batched van Genuchten Se(pc) compute kernel, target-gated OFF Android (verified no wgpu in aarch64-linux-android dep graph), mandatory CPU fallback, f32 GPU vs trusted f64 CPU. REMAINING before close: GPU dispatch path unverified (no GPU in dev env - CPU fallback only); wire GPU into the solver hot loop; scale-out/MPI still deferred. All 116 tests green.
